name: @ayar/desktop
description: AYAR macOS app: Electron main process, sandboxed preload and an empty Svelte mount point. Everything it runs is bundled into dist/, so it has no runtime dependencies.

scripts.build: AYAR_GALLERY= vite build -c vite.renderer.config.ts && vite build -c vite.preload.config.ts && vite build -c vite.main.config.ts && vite build -c vite.engine.config.ts && node ../../tools/packaging/make-icns.mjs
scripts.typecheck: node ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p src/main/tsconfig.json && node ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p src/preload/tsconfig.json && node ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && svelte-check --tsconfig ./src/renderer/tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:gallery && (vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts; status=$?; AYAR_GALLERY= vite build -c vite.renderer.config.ts --logLevel warn; exit $status)
scripts.gallery: npm run build && npm run build:gallery && (node test/gallery/open.ts; status=$?; AYAR_GALLERY= vite build -c vite.renderer.config.ts --logLevel warn; exit $status)
